utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa, I’ve got the repair drive down for the school parking lot at 9 a.m., and Leo’s porch drop-off cutoff is before 6.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—small update: the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so please swap out the school lot note and hold off on Leo’s porch drop-off timing for now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll update it to Sunday at the community center and pause the Leo porch drop-off note until we get a new time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits so far, but I’m asking around about who can bring tools and what folks need fixed so Rosa can sort the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s a big help, Nell—if you hear of anyone still on the fence, send them our way and let them know the repair drive’s running all afternoon Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn—that helps a lot. I’ll pass along that it’s all afternoon Saturday and keep gathering names for Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rey, the repair drive’s this Saturday and running all afternoon—I’ve got the supplies list with me if you want the quick rundown.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks—I only know the folding tables still need repair, and Sam said he’d bring the basic tools, so a quick rundown would help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: So far it’s the folding tables plus whatever neighbors bring by, and Sam’s covering the basic tools—if you can, spread the word that we’ll be fixing things all afternoon Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Hana—so it is this Saturday at 9, right? I’ll bring the spare cords and little appliances, not tools, unless you’ve heard otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d heard Saturday afternoon, not 9, and the focus was still bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture—can we double-check the time before we lock that in?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—good catch, Hana, now I’m mixed up again; I’d better double-check the time before I show up at the wrong hour.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s in the school parking lot starting at 9, and I’m heading over right after school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—maybe I missed an update, because I still had it as Saturday afternoon for bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I heard 9 a.m. in the school parking lot, and they specifically mentioned spare cords and small appliances—not tools or a bike setup, but I can double-check when I get there after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Uli, if you can lend a hand, we’re sorting tools and setting up the folding tables for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little with the tool list, if that’s alright. I only know the folding tables still need repair, and Sam said he’s bringing the basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s plenty, Uli—thanks. If you can start the tool list, I’ll have Sam handle the tables and we’ll see what still needs doing this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mina—I’m still out on errands, so just keep me posted this afternoon on what gets fixed and what’s still left.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I will, but before that—who’s the organizer, and can you get me direct confirmation today on the date, pickup details, and exactly what Sam’s bringing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, so I can’t confirm those details myself right now—please check with the organizer directly and send me whatever you hear this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Vik, I’m keeping a simple list of what’s fixed and what’s still pending, and I’ll share a clear update this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Eli—I’ve been telling folks to keep an eye out, so once you share that update this afternoon, I’ll pass it around the block.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Vik—that keeps it straightforward. I’ll have the update ready this afternoon with what’s done and what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help, Tess—I’m set to be at Leo’s porch around 5 to sort the basic tools and help get the tables set up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Sam—Leo’s porch should be buzzing by then, and I’ll make sure folks know you’re helping get the tools and tables in order.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Tess—I’ll head straight to Leo’s porch at 5 and get the tables and tool box sorted as soon as I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still not comfortable assuming it’s on until we have the organizer’s name and a direct confirmation on the date and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, let’s get the organizer’s name and a direct confirmation first—who actually confirmed the date and pickup details?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s exactly my concern—I haven’t heard a named contact yet, so I really don’t want anyone bringing things over until we get direct confirmation on the date and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and where do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still on—come by my porch, and if you can, help Sam with the tables and tool box setup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’m heading to your porch now and I’ll give Sam a hand with the tables and toolbox setup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still tracking Saturday afternoon for bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture, and I can start telling a few neighbors to get a rough headcount.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that works—just keep it rough; the key bits are school lot at 9 and Leo’s porch before 6 with notes on weird stuff.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it—I’ll keep the headcount rough and let folks know it’s the school lot at 9, with anything weird dropped on Leo’s porch before 6 with a note.
